comments.body: Based on #2555 it should be known issue, but not fully sure.

I think being able to build the document is useful, especially if someone makes a fork and wants to make changes for the own purposes. As we don't use the document build scripts locally much, they are not as well tested as we would like.

I would however point out that this repository runs the document build on every new commit. You can find the most recent version by opening the most recent completed action on this page:
https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/actions/workflows/build-documents.yml?query=branch%3Amaster

I presume that when forking this repo the actions would continue to work in that way

labels.name: _5.0 - Not blocker
labels.description: This issue does not block 5.0 so if it gets addressed then great, if not then fine.
